rows.en:
Hey, Goro…

You're going without telling [HERO2] and the others anything?

Oyassan… This time, there's no guarantee we'll come out alive.

Besides… even if we manage to sneak into Desper City, we don't even know if we can make it back!
Even so…
Oyassan… If everyone gets killed, who's going to protect the peace of the Earth?
Goro, you…
Come on, Mr. Arai… let's go!

This is it, no doubt about it!

Desper City… It's just like the streets of Tokyo!
Geisel built an exact copy…
And an artificial sun, too…?
Don't move!

…!?

You are!?
The mayor of Desper City… Sadesper! It's as if you came here to die, Goro Watari…!
Sadesper?
Receive the judgment of Fuhrer Geisel! Take them away!
We got caught, but… we made it inside their headquarters.

Yes… But we don't have much time! We have to find your wife and daughter fast…

And stop Geisel's operation to destroy all of Japan!
Right…
The prisoners are escaping!
Fuhrer, I'm terribly sorry. I let the two of them get away…

What audacity…

Sadesper! [VAR6] must not leave Desper City! Use our final trump card!
You mean… blow up the artificial sun…?

Wipe out [VAR6] along with the fifty thousand citizens!

And then… carry out the final plan at once!

That artificial sun has a nuclear explosive device based on element NM built into it.

It will act on the volcanic belt flowing beneath all of Japan, and in an instant, Japan will sink to the bottom of the sea!

Leaving only a certain region, where we will build our empire… Sadesper, you will be the sacrifice!
Mr. Arai…
My wife and daughter are probably…
being forced to work in that Desper City factory, I'm sure of it…
Let's go rescue them right away!
Goro Watari… and Makoto Arai! You won't leave Desper City alive!
The Udesper brothers! And Sadesper!
Looks like… they won't let us through easily.
Curse you… But don't forget! You won't leave Desper City alive!
Ngh… Damn you, [VAR6]…!
Nuoooh…

[VAR6]… I can never hate him enough!

He has thwarted every one of our Desper plans!

I have abandoned my ambition to rule all of Japan. We… must build a new Desper Empire!

Set the artificial sun to explode in one hour!

Isn't it great, Mr. Arai? You found your wife and daughter!

This is the first time I've seen you look this happy.
Chizuko… take everyone and get out of here!
Mr. Arai, I'll handle the rest! You've finally been reunited with your wife and daughter. You take everyone and…
Goro, don't be ridiculous!
I'm a secret agent of Interpol! Before the great mission of striking down the Desper, there's no room for personal feelings!
Papa…
Chizuko, I joined Interpol to strike down the Desper. You understand, don't you? You too, Rumi…
Yes…
Sadesper's coming! Both of you, hurry and hide!
Hey! Goro Watari came here, didn't he? Where is he hiding?
How should I know!
If you don't want to talk, that's fine. The artificial sun… will explode today at 19:30!

What!? The artificial sun…?

There's only thirty minutes left!
Tell Goro Watari… no matter how much he struggles in this Desper City, it's already too late!
The artificial sun is going to explode!? What on earth does this mean?
There are rumors that the artificial sun has a bomb using element NM built into it, for emergencies.

I see… So that's Geisel's operation to destroy all of Japan…

Damn… He means to kill every one of the Desper citizens!?
If that's true, not only Japan but the life of the Earth itself is in danger…
We have to stop the explosion somehow!
And to do that… we have no choice but to defeat Fuhrer Geisel!
Mm… Let's hurry! We're out of time!

Found you, Goro Watari! This time you won't escape!

Goro Watari, this is your grave!

…!?

Sadesper, you're still alive!?

But it's not all bad news!

According to Chizuko… this Desper City has the same city functions as Tokyo… We might be able to use the factories and power plants here.
At this rate, the detonator… we'll never make it in time!
At this rate, the detonator… we'll never make it in time!
At this rate, the detonator… we'll never make it in time!
It's fine, then! We already disarmed the detonator…
Everyone!? How did you get here?
Everyone!? How did you get here?
Everyone!? How did you get here?

It was simple!

Thanks to Taki! The FBI is who provided the information to your Interpol, Mr. Arai…

And as for decoding the encrypted documents, we had Interpol's Destron Hunter, Tadokoro, do it for us!
I see, Tadokoro did…? Decoding encrypted documents is his specialty…
Hey, hey… Looks like there's no time to sit around chatting.

Nuoooh…

Ngh… Glory to the Desper Army! Fuhrer Geisel!
Nuoooh… Inazu… man… Gwah…!
Ugaaah… Udesper never dies! Inazu… man… Ghh…!

Mr. Arai, your wife and daughter…

I'll go after Fuhrer Geisel!

Mr. Arai, your wife and daughter…

I'll go after Fuhrer Geisel!

Mr. Arai, your wife and daughter…

I'll go after Fuhrer Geisel!
Mm… Hurry, get Geisel…!
So you've finally come…
Geisel!
I will not let anyone who defies me live! Here I come, [VAR6]!
Geisel… I can't forgive anyone without a human heart!

uncertain: U12110-U12112: Mysterious Cyborg Warrior is Sadesper before the reveal.
U12118-U12119: Desper Soldier's line continues in a narration-kind row (no closing bracket).
U12123: 様牲 read as 犠牲; 薬く read as 築く; "fifty thousand citizens" for 5万の市民.
U12126-U12127: one sentence split across two rows; cut at the matching point.
U12139-U12140: Arai's line continues in a narration-kind row.
U12144-U12146: speaker Desper City Citizen (several citizens) shield the heroes.
U12167: 握供 read as 提供 "provided"; 害類 read as 書類; [ja] rendered "Interpol's Destron Hunter, Tadokoro" (not Dr. Tadokoro of the glossary).
U12171/U12172: dying Udesper calls "Inazu…man" even if the player's hero name differs ([VAR6] not used in the Japanese).
omissions_kept: U12124: Sadesper's silent reaction to being made the sacrifice kept.

new_names.why: Interpol Destron Hunter (glossary has Dr. Tadokoro only)
